text:
Megiston called strong people at the arena and
began a fighting competition.
Only "strong people" are qualified to participate
in it, and you are required to get certain items
from mighty enemy.
5 Battles in Total.

[ffff64][NOTE]
- The items will be consumed after the 1st battle.
- You have to start over again if you leave the venue.
- You have to start over again if you fall from the arena.
